titulo: Torres fires Spain past Argentina in extra time to win World Cup, denying Messi a 2nd title
cuerpo: Ferran Torres' first goal of this year's World Cup was the goal of his life, and it put Spain back atop the soccer world. Denying Lionel Messi a second straight title, Torres came off the bench and scored in the 106th minute and Spain ended Argentina's reign with a 1-0 win on Sunday.
